ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance, Actuarial Science, 1st Stage Accountancy majors. On November 24th, any remaining seats will be closed and seat limits will be set below the number of registered students. Registered students who drop the course can request to reregister for the dropped section, space permitting. Prerequisite (FIN 221) will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 221 will be removed from FIN 300.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Finance or Actuarial Science major(s).
